headline: Amazon's Zoox launches paid robotaxi rides in Las Vegas
summary: Starting August 10, Zoox will charge fares for driverless, steering-wheel-free rides in Vegas — a US first for controls-free autonomy.
script: Amazon's Zoox will start paid robotaxi rides in Las Vegas next week. It is the first US service to charge for rides in vehicles with no steering wheel. Federal regulators approved the driverless cars.
imageAlt: A Zoox autonomous robotaxi parked at night in Las Vegas near neon signs.
imageAltTwo: A close view of the Zoox driverless robotaxi vehicle.
